descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The open road, from the driver's seat - in Munich.

A REAL CITY LOOP
65 km of Munich built from real map data: the A99 Autobahnring, the Kreuz München-Nord loop ramp onto the A9 past the Allianz Arena, the Mittlerer Ring past the Olympiaturm and BMW, over the Donnersbergerbrücke and the Isar, then the A995 and back.

A SHOW TRUCK TO CALL HOME
Walnut dash, cognac tufting, fourteen working gauges and a starlight headliner. Grip the wheel with your own hands, pull the air horn, set the parking brake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 10-SPEED
Drive AUTOMATIC, or switch to MANUAL and float a 10-speed through the H-pattern with a LO/HI range. Miss a shift and it grinds.

HAUL REAL LOADS
Six depots from Ismaning to the Autohof Aschheim. Back under your trailer, merge into traffic and deliver. Dock it clean for a bonus, climb the ranks, get paid in euros.

DAY AND NIGHT
Drive at noon or after dark - the Allianz Arena glows red. Night runs pay extra.

ON THE RADIO
A real dispatcher and five truckers on the CB with local road talk and Blitzer warnings.

THE SLEEPER
Leave the seat, walk back into the sleeper and sleep through to morning.

ENGLISH AND GERMAN
Menus, hints and the nav screen in English or German.

Plus 18 achievements, 9 paints to unlock, a live map and seat adjustment.
